purpose: Cross-revision musical sound identity and editable basic-control qualification; musical polish still requires listening review

criteria: usable as a musical starting sound
no unintended transient or harsh tail
brightness, volume, onset and fade edits are easy to hear
listeningReview.limitation: Automated compatibility is not evidence that users find these sounds polished

toleranceRationale: Original modulation nodes disconnect from ended handlers on the control thread. Self-comparisons expose variation near source teardown; allow at most -100 dBFS sample error and -140 dBFS RMS across revisions, and separately gate current-render repeatability at 1e-7. The original 60 steady reference gates are unchanged.
